domain_interpretation: Duration in minutes between pick start and finish. Core warehouse labor efficiency metric.
Operational grouping of orders into Small (1-3), Medium (4-7), Large (8-12), Bulk (13+).
Time required to pick each individual unit of an item SKU (pace metric).
Rank of travel distance from shipping dispatch (Near: 1, Mid: 2, Far: 3, Deep-Storage: 4).
Operational access hurdle (Fast-Moving: 1, Mezzanine: 3, High-Rack/Cold Vault/Bulk: 4).
Tenure tier of the warehouse associate (Novice: 1, Intermediate: 2, Senior: 3).
Composite physical handling friction index combining item dimensions and hazardous/cold/security storage rules.
Latency in minutes between order placement/release and pick execution start.
SLA urgency tier (Low: 1, Medium: 2, High: 3, Urgent: 4).
Hour of day (0-23) indicating diurnal shift progression and circadian fatigue factors.
